metadata.description: Software architecture plugins for Claude Code: DDD, microservices, distributed systems, event-driven design, resilience, data, and migration patterns.

plugins.name: api-gateway
plugins.description: API gateway design: gateway topology, backend-for-frontend, routing, edge authentication, rate limiting, and API versioning.

plugins.name: architecture-decision-records
plugins.description: Architecture Decision Records: write, maintain, supersede, and enforce decisions in Nygard or MADR format.

plugins.name: caching-strategies
plugins.description: Caching strategy: cache-aside, write-through, write-behind, invalidation, stampede prevention, Redis, and CDN caching.

plugins.name: circuit-breaker
plugins.description: Resilience patterns: circuit breakers, bulkheads, timeouts, retries with jitter, and fallbacks that stop cascading failures.

plugins.name: clean-architecture
plugins.description: Clean Architecture: the dependency rule, use case interactors, ports, and business logic free of framework coupling.

plugins.name: cqrs-event-sourcing
plugins.description: CQRS and event sourcing: command handlers, event stores, projections, snapshots, and event versioning.

plugins.name: data-consistency
plugins.description: Data consistency: CAP and PACELC, consistency models, CRDTs, vector clocks, quorums, two-phase commit, and sagas.

plugins.name: database-patterns
plugins.description: Database architecture: repositories, Unit of Work, N+1 prevention, read replicas, connection pools, and sharding.

plugins.name: distributed-systems
plugins.description: Distributed systems: consensus with Raft and Paxos, leader election, distributed locks, gossip, consistent hashing, and partitions.

plugins.name: domain-driven-design
plugins.description: Domain-Driven Design: bounded contexts, context maps, aggregates, value objects, domain events, and event storming.

plugins.name: event-driven
plugins.description: Event-driven architecture: broker choice, choreography vs orchestration, the outbox pattern, dead letter queues, and schema evolution.

plugins.name: hexagonal-architecture
plugins.description: Hexagonal architecture: ports and adapters, dependency direction, and framework-free testing of the application core.

plugins.name: message-queues
plugins.description: Message brokers: RabbitMQ, Kafka, SQS/SNS, and Azure Service Bus topology, delivery semantics, and dead letter queues.

plugins.name: microservices
plugins.description: Microservices: service boundaries, inter-service communication, data ownership, service mesh, and observability.

plugins.name: migration-strategies
plugins.description: System migration: strangler fig, branch by abstraction, parallel run, expand-contract schema changes, and canary cutover.

plugins.name: monolith-patterns
plugins.description: Modular monoliths: module boundaries, vertical slices, and knowing when a monolith wins and when to split.

plugins.name: saga-patterns
plugins.description: Sagas: orchestration vs choreography, compensating transactions, isolation countermeasures, and failure recovery.

plugins.name: scalability-patterns
plugins.description: Scalability: horizontal and vertical scaling, load balancing, auto-scaling, read/write splitting, and capacity planning.

plugins.name: service-discovery
plugins.description: Service discovery: Kubernetes DNS, Consul, and Eureka, health checks, and client-side vs server-side discovery.

plugins.name: system-design
plugins.description: System design: requirements, back-of-envelope estimation, component selection, and explicit trade-offs.
